requests.name: m_mucus_coating_thin
requests.why: 소화_9 '진통제가 코팅(위 점액)을 만드는 일까지 멈춰 코팅이 얇아진다' 칸(2026-09-29 싱크 점검). 기존 m_hormone_drop은 수용체에 알갱이가 끊기는 장면이라 코팅과 거리가 있다. 위벽 세포 위를 덮은 점액 층이 점점 얇아지며 세포가 드러나는 장면(m_mucus_barrier의 반대).
requests.midjourney: Medical holographic visualization, extreme microscopic close-up of translucent glass-like 3D human tissue, every structure rendered in the same soft pale cyan glow, dark empty slate blue-grey void, cinematic soft rim lighting, shallow depth of field, the subject filling most of the frame, a tightly packed layer of square stomach lining cells covered by a thick glossy amber mucus coating like a smooth gel layer
requests.flow: One continuous shot in a single unbroken scene with no scene cuts, the camera slowly drifting low across the surface. 0-2s: a tightly packed layer of square pale cyan stomach lining cells, and a thick glossy amber gel pours out from between the cells and spreads over the top, covering the whole surface in a smooth shining coat. 2-4s: the amber gel stops coming out from between the cells, and the coat thins steadily, sinking lower until the tops of the cells begin to show through. 4-6s: only a thin patchy film of amber remains, bare pale cyan cells exposed in wide gaps, a few drops of bright acid falling onto the bare cells and making them flare. Every structure rendered in the same soft pale cyan glow except the amber, dark empty slate blue-grey void. No text, no letters, no numbers, no labels, no arrows anywhere in the frame. Low ambient synth hum only, no music, no dialogue.
requests._flow_redo_why: 2026-09-29 받은 스틸(--sref)엔 점액 코팅이 없고 맨 세포층만 나왔다 — Flow에서 코팅이 덮였다가 얇아지게 순서를 바꿈.
